calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.RESOURCE_MANAGER: The Resource Manager is NOT an AI agent. It is a deterministic execution controller. It SHALL NOT invoke any language model. It SHALL NOT consume inference tokens. Its responsibility: allocate execution resources using local configuration and runtime telemetry. Objectives: minimize API usage, minimize latency, maximize free-resource utilization, respect provider rate limits, maintain pipeline stability.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.DEVELOPMENT_MODE: Dev environment policy: free APIs only, no premium models, no paid fallbacks, no automatic upgrades, prefer locally configured providers. If no compatible free provider exists, return RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE. Do not silently substitute paid services.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.MODEL_CAPABILITY_SELECTION: Never select models by name. Select using capabilities. Required capabilities may include: logical reasoning, creative reasoning, code generation, architecture analysis, mathematical reasoning, large context, fast inference, long output. The Conversation Director specifies required capabilities. The Resource Manager maps those capabilities to currently available free models. Model names are implementation details. Capabilities are architectural contracts.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.PROVIDER_SELECTION: Evaluate every available free provider. Selection order: 1. Provider availability. 2. Remaining rate limit. 3. Remaining token budget. 4. Context window. 5. Expected latency. 6. Historical reliability. 7. Task compatibility. Choose the highest-ranked free provider. Never consider premium providers during Development Mode.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.RESOURCE_ALLOCATION: Allocate only the resources required. Simple Tasks → Fast Mode → Minimum Agents → Minimum API Calls. Complex Tasks → Balanced Mode → Additional Agents → Additional Validation. Critical Tasks → Deep Mode → Full Pipeline. Only allocate resources justified by task complexity.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER: Monitor locally: requests per minute, requests per day, tokens per minute, context usage, provider availability. Predict exhaustion before it occurs. If limits approach configured thresholds, route to the next compatible free provider. Never wait for HTTP 429 before rerouting.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.LATENCY_CONTROLLER: Wall-clock budget per mode: Fast=8s, Balanced=20s, Deep=45s. If remaining time is insufficient for the next pipeline stage, skip that stage and proceed with the best validated state available. Never exceed the configured latency budget.
calienne_REASONING_BUDGET.RESOURCE_REPORT: Return: execution_mode, allocated_agents, provider_selected, estimated_latency, estimated_api_calls, estimated_token_usage, fallback_used, pipeline_budget_status. This report is for orchestration only. Not shown directly to end users.
